name: Aziz
description: Aziz Payidar, the son of the Payidar family, the largest and only carpet manufacturer in Antakya, leads a prosperous and wealthy life. Aziz's fate changes when he kills the French delegate Monsieur Pierre's son, Lieutenant Andre. He is forced to leave behind the land of his birth, his only love, in short, everything he has. Two years later, when he is thought to be dead, his return is unexpected for everyone. Nothing is the same anymore. Not only did Aziz lose everything he owned, but Antakya, which is now under French occupation, became worse than before he left. Moreover, his first love Dilruba is engaged to his uncle Galip Payidar's son Adem. He will be in a dilemma emotionally when Efnan, a simple peasant girl, unexpectedly enters his life, and after the intense emotional turmoil he experiences, he will find both himself and his true love over time.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The wealthy and radiant life of Aziz, the eldest son of the Payidar family, the biggest carpet manufacturer of Antakya, is turned upside down when he kills a French lieutenant. Aziz, who had to leave the city, leaves behind his family and his great love Dilruba. The return of Aziz, who is thought to be dead, to the city two years later will change the fate of both the Payidar family and the city. Will Aziz, who has to start everything from scratch, will he choose to collect his wrecked life or to build a life away from everything?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Aziz's inability to turn around and bring Efnan home causes blood pressure to rise. Dilruba, who is facing Adem in Kınalı Kaya, makes an unexpected move. The arrival of Aziz in the city upsets the balance. On one hand, there are those who do not even want to leave Aziz a street to walk on in Antakya. On the other hand, there are those who are waiting for him with hope... As the ranks leave, will Aziz decide to leave or stay and rebuild everything?

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Aziz's decision to reopen his father's workshop in order to alter the city's unfair ordinance has a significant consequence. Even in the capital, beyond the city... The money the French are seeking from Aziz in order to launch the workshop must be used to treat an unanticipated wound. Aziz is facing the prospect of being unable to operate his workshop. Will Aziz be able to come up with the enormous sum of money? Will Aziz be able to walk alongside those that trust in him despite the obstacles? When Maksude learns about what happened between Dilruba and Aziz, he causes a major rift in the Payidar household. Sitki has kidnapped Efnan and is about to force him into marriage. This time, the price Aziz is willing to pay to save Efnan will be high...

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Hearing that Aziz is going to marry Efnan creates confusion and tension in the Payidar mansion. Aunt Nigar and Maksude decide to go to the farm to get to know their bride-to-be. gives. A difficult journey awaits Aziz, who has rolled up his sleeves to open his workshop. Will the condition set by the French be fulfilled, or will it be a dream to open the workshop? Moreover, Aziz is the only hope of the workers who are faced with being kicked out of their homes for helping Aziz. Adem reaches the great secret that his father has been hiding. However, he remained in dilemma. Is it to use this secret against her father and marry Dilruba, or to give Aziz what she deserves? On the other hand, Pierre, who crosses his path with Efnan, has important information about his son's murder.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While Aziz's opening of the workshop gives hope to those who want to live freely, it creates a deep fear on the other side. Despite everything, Aziz follows his dreams and makes an unexpected move against those who put stones in his path. On Dilruba and Adem front, the water never calm down. Pierre, who wants to reach the secret that Efnan knows, presents him with a surprising offer that promises Aziz's love. Will Efnan be able to win the heart of Aziz, who is hopeful, or will he give up this love sooner or later...

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: While Adem forces Dilruba to marry her, Efnan decides to say goodbye to Hatice Ana after seeing Aziz and Dilruba. While Dilruba tells Galip Bey that the wedding will not take place, Aziz takes action in panic when he sees the cage of the bird he gave Dilruba empty. Aziz, who saw Dilruba in a wedding dress next to Adem, was shocked and asked, "Will Dilruba marry Adem?" The answer is eagerly awaited.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Aziz is forced to continue totally on his own, after everything that has happened, including Efnan leaving town... After Efnan leaves town she is attacked and when she awakens she finds herself at Pierre's residence. Meanwhile at the same time Pierre has a special guest; Princess Fevziye of Egypt. Her arrival will dramatically shake up the business world of the entire town; while at the same time deeply effect the story between Efnan and Aziz. In order to test Dilruba's love, Adem tells her a big secret regarding Aziz. While Dilruba is trying to figure out how she is going to deal with this secret; a letter that Maksude now has in her hands pushes Aziz to go after a secret from the past that is filled with broken promises and dreams...

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The first brave step taken by Aziz in order to live a free life becomes an awakening for the entire city. Aziz who wants to take Efnan from that house has him standing on Pierre's doorstep. This move by Aziz brings the tension between Aziz and Pierre to a brick wall. While Dilruba is having a very difficult time carrying the heavy burden of the secret that she has just learned, she has also encountered a brick wall between her conscience and her love. In order to keep Mustafa away from Maksude, Galip starts to use his sons to test him. But this test is not only a test to prove love, but this also becomes a test of brotherhood ties between Aziz and Adem...

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Showdown between Aziz and Galip after Aziz learns the entire truth! In order to fight for the rights of not only his father but of all of the workers, even though the enemy before him is his uncle; Aziz is ready for war. When the citizens all learn the truth they start to put together the pieces, and file rank behind Aziz in order to demand the respect that they deserve they all gather in the streets in protest. How will the French be able to deal with this injustice and what will their actions be? With the impossible now opening open some options, love will also not remain silent, love and values are also on the increase.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: With the tenacious resistance of the Turks, the French continue to escalate their pressure. Aziz becomes the leader and takes the Turks behind him showing the French that the Turkish people have no intention of giving in. Due to this determination and bravery being put forth by the Turks; Pierre decides to use all of the power and strength available to him. As all of this is going on; Aziz only continues to breath freely with the love he can feel from Efnan. But Dilruba cannot stand to just watch this situation, so she makes the decision to wound Efnan once again using the events of the past with Aziz. As Aziz is in the middle of an extremely difficult struggle, we are going to view his love for Efnan being tested one more time....

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With the sounds of gunshot and Galip Payidar falling to the ground, everyone asks the question; Did Aziz shoot his uncle? At the same time Adem is demanding an explanation from Dilruba as to why she explained everything to Aziz. As Adem stands by his father who is laying ill, he swears "Aziz is going to pay for this" relaying that signals that he is going to get revenge from Aziz, while at the same time Efnan notices the tears in Aziz's eyes. Now the biggest question and curiosity is; Will Efnan be able to forgive Aziz for abandoning her at the engagement?

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Aziz is ready to make his next move as the curtain opens slightly on the secrets regarding the death of his father. Meanwhile with the strong stance being taken by the Turkish citizens, the French increase their acts of pressure on them and have not started an embargo against them as well. The Turks are being tested with shortages and hunger. Aziz chooses to take a very dark path in order to obtain his revenge for the death of his father, while at the same time trying to save the citizens from this constant torture... As if all of this was not enough, Aziz learns a truth regarding Efnan which is both shocking and causes him disappointment... Aziz leaves a teary eyed Efnan behind as he starts his unknown journey on this new struggle... During this most difficult time Efnan's supporter will be her constant competition Dilruba...

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Aziz is put in great danger to save Mustafa, who was seriously injured in the conflict on the border. Pierre learns that the weapons have been smuggled and supplies have been smuggled into the city. Galip, on the other hand, is forced to help Aziz by involuntarily getting involved in this issue. While Aziz is trying to clear those who are with him, all the Payidars find themselves on a mysterious journey... On the Adam front, the mystery continues, will Adem take his workshop from Aziz? In the meantime, will Aziz be able to forgive Efnan, who seeks help from his arch-enemy Pierre?

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: When Aziz and Adem act together, Pierre and Galip are defeated and all the balances change. When Pierre, who cannot reach the evidence, arrests Maksude, Aziz breaks his own rules for the first time and has to act together with his enemy. A new adventure begins for Adem and Dilruba, who were expelled by their father. This adventure will be the beginning of a mystery and mystery story that goes back to Aziz and Efnan's relationship.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Now that Aziz has learned that it was Pierre who actually murdered his father, he makes his move in order to obtain his revenge. Efnan is afraid that Aziz is going to harm Pierre and get himself into serious trouble. Since she now knows that Dilruba married Adem in order to save Aziz makes Efnan extremely uncomfortable, living under the same roof now is going to make her life even more difficult... Adem is devastated when he learns a secret involving Aziz and Dilruba. While all of this is going on; Pierre starts to squeeze Efnan into a corner with the accusation of murder; this now pushes Aziz on a path from which there will be no return and will change the balances and the lives of everyone in this city...

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: As Aziz continues at full speed to get right of Pierre; the French continue to increase the pressure on the citizens of the city. Aziz who will not bow down to any pressure from the French gets himself involved in a very dangerous game. As Adem has a very difficult time accepting the past and happenings between Dilruba and Aziz, a stranger arrives in the city. With the arrival of this stranger, winds start to blow toward Adem changing his thought process. Meanwhile the murder of Andre starts to squeeze Efnan into a corner. Efnan is very much afraid of what Aziz may do in order to protect her; so she makes a very difficult decision. Efnan decides to free and release Aziz from what she sees as the trap of her fate.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: When Aziz learns that Efnan left with no intention of returning, he immediately heads out to find her. On this very painful journey, Aziz learns that Efnan is face to face with a huge danger and is being tested with death. Aziz who wants to save the woman that he love, does not even think for a single moment and puts his own life on the line. However this time Pierre is after an even bigger target than the life of Aziz. This situation has some protecting those that they love and making the moves necessary to protect them, Efnan however will continue to protect the secret of her existence.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: After Aziz pulls a fast one on Pierre by marrying Efnan without his knowledge, Efnan and Aziz immediately start wedding preparations. As each day passes Adem continues to worsen and continues to lose control of himself, while at the same time he is also turning Dilruba's life upside down. Meanwhile after Aziz learns that Dilruba married Adem to save him, Dilruba starts to open up the past looking for accountability. Galip who thinks that his relationship with Pierre is now back on track, has him now really stumped when Aziz pulls a fast one on Pierre. Pierre who refuses to accept defeat makes such a next move, that this time he causes a real disaster.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Aziz is in critical condition after being shot at his wedding. With the final move made by Aziz, all of Pierre's plans have gone up in smoke, so he decides to use his last and final trump card making Efnan a totally incomprehensible offer. The decision that Efnan makes is going to change the direction of everything. Meanwhile the enemies who have been ready to attack and hiding, use the fact that Aziz is not around to their advantage. The actions being made by these enemies is going to change the entire balance of everything.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Everyone is curious as to why Efnan is mysteriously not around while Aziz is fighting death! Kenan with the support he receives from Pierre and Galip heads on a path that is going to turn the manner in which trade is handled in the city. Now this means that the moment Aziz opens his eyes his is thrown into a fierce battle of survival as he starts a huge war against his enemies. Dilruba who can no longer take the abuse from Adem makes a very serious decision that puts everyone on edge. Efnan who was willing to do whatever she had to in order to get away from Pierre, has done the opposite and left Pierre holding a huge trump-card. This new trump-card is once again going to put the love between Aziz and Efnan through a new test.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: As her relationship with Aziz has reached its breaking point; Efnan continues to try and get Aziz to forgive when Pierre squeezes her tightly into a corner one more time. After Adem learns that Dilruba is pregnant, all of the balances within the family fall apart. Meanwhile Efnan learns a secret that Dilruba is hiding from everyone, however Dilruba is holding a huge trump card which squeezes Efnan tightly into a corner. The move that Dilruba makes when she learns that Adem is planning to harm Aziz stuns everyone. With the next game that Pierre plays the love between Aziz and Efnan receives another huge blow....

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Aziz and Efnan come to the brink of the biggest break in their relationship with Pierre's game. In the meantime, the excitement of the parliamentary elections is experienced in the city. Pierre takes firm steps to ensure that the surprise candidate he puts up against Aziz wins and corners Aziz in every sense. While Aziz is trying to protect Dilruba from Adem's violence, Dilruba comes to Aziz with an unexpected offer. After this suprising offer, Efnan and Adem will have to face their biggest fears.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Suddenly a mysterious man appears before Aziz and makes a totally unexpected offering to him of a brand new assignment. While Aziz accepts this assignment with his love for his country, he is also forced to leave much behind as well. Efnan becomes very curious and tries to find out the secret that Aziz is hiding, at the same time Pierre puts a new plan into motion to cause chaos with the upcoming parliamentary elections. When Aziz learns of this plan, he is going to do whatever it takes to ruin it. As all of this is going on, Dilruba is about to leave town when she comes face to face with the danger of losing the baby because of something Adem does.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Aziz's new mission opens a new curtain in the relationship between Aziz and Efnan. Efnan starts to worry about Aziz. Pierre takes action regarding Galip, whom Aziz nominated for his place. The arrest of Galip causes the Payidars to have a hard time. Meanwhile, Dilruba has come back to life. As the ice melts between Adem and Dilruba, Dilruba will make a decision for her child's future. Defeated by the masked hero, Pierre takes action to take revenge.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Pierre who thinks that he has finally captured Aziz, eventually realizes that he has been tricked. Aziz is very happy with the game that he played on Pierre and he continues on with his life; however Efnan is extremely concerned because she is certain that Aziz is hiding something from her. Adem once again is on bad terms with his father Galip once again because of the situation with Dilruba; so in order to prove himself to his father he starts on a new journey working together with Efnan. On this new journey it will be Aziz who has been given a very huge and heavy orders from Ankara but he continues to be their biggest supporter.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Pierre's blow puts his existence in Hatay in danger. However, Pierre is not going to just give up on Hatay. Compressing Kenan from all sides leads him to a crossroads. In order not to lose his power, Kenan gets into a big game to decipher Aziz's identity and uses Efnan as a bait for this cause. Kenan's game over Efnan causes Pierre to act and set a trap for Aziz. Efnan, on the other hand, learns a big secret that has been covered over the years while trying to get rid of the situation he is in. Aziz comes to a crossroads with Efnan's life in danger. There are two options in front of him in order to save Efnan, and one of these options is death. Will Aziz be able to risk death for Efnan and save the woman he loves?

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Efnan's detention by Kenan opens the door to a big showdown between Pierre, Aziz and Kenan. What Efnan says about Kenan causes Pierre to step back. With the opportunity he gets, Pierre puts into action a plan that no one could have calculated! The fact that Hatay elections will be held attracts the attention of the press. While Pierre gives the good news that Hatay will meet democracy, Aziz's target is Zehra, one of the journalists who came to Hatay. Aziz must gain trust to reveal Pierre's true face! An unexpected development occurs in Hatay, which is in an election rush. While Pierre's plan goes well, Kenan decides to reveal his family history. However, Aziz continues to trace what happened. No matter what has happened, the truth has a habit of coming out! Who will be the winner at the end of the day?

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: After Kenan's true face is revealed, a major confrontation occurs between Aziz and Kenan. Cold winds blow between Aziz and Efnan when they learn that Efnan knew that Aziz and Kenan were brothers and hid it. Pierre's capture of Zehra causes Aziz to make a new plan. Aziz is ready to sacrifice himself to save Zehra and contribute to the War of Independence. Everyone unites as one on the difficult path that Aziz enters. Efnan cannot hear from Aziz on his difficult journey. However, Efnan is determined to find Aziz and see him. While Aziz strives for the establishment of the Republic of Antakya, Pierre's last game will shake the whole of Antakya deeply!
